public.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
public.description: Return node values grouped by depth, from root level downward and left to right within each level. An empty tree returns []. Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: read the root, then left and right child slots for each non-null node in queue order. null marks a missing child; absent trailing slots are null. [] is empty. Values are integers from -10000 to 10000 and there are at most 200 nodes.
hints: Process the queue one depth at a time.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Breadth-first traversal separates consecutive queue layers. O(n) time and O(n) space.
